name: naive
note: naive is HTTP/2 CONNECT: TCP only as minted today (no udp_over_tcp), so an app's UDP datagrams do NOT pass. udp=blocked is a DECLARED PRODUCT LIMITATION (FINDINGS FAM-6, open), not a property worth having: a green cell here means the limitation is still there. When a pack carries UDP on naive this check goes red; flip it to pass. Names must still resolve (dns=pass): engine_singbox.go says so in as many words. The client needs Cronet; run.sh stages the linux build that sing-box's own dependency (cronet-go) ships as a Go module.
